---- MODULE W4Od0m0p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Theatres, Budget, MaxGrant, MaxVersion

\* A grant carries minutes that have already left the pool, so what is in transit
\* has to be counted alongside what is banked.
Grants == [to : Theatres, mins : 1..MaxGrant, base : 0..MaxVersion]

VARIABLES pool, allotted, circulating, version

vars == <<pool, allotted, circulating, version>>

RECURSIVE Banked(_)
Banked(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET t == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN allotted[t] + Banked(S \ {t})

RECURSIVE Carried(_)
Carried(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET g == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN g.mins + Carried(S \ {g})

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..Budget
    /\ allotted \in [Theatres -> 0..Budget]
    /\ circulating \in SUBSET Grants
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVersion

Init ==
    /\ pool = Budget
    /\ allotted = [t \in Theatres |-> 0]
    /\ circulating = {}
    /\ version = 0

Issue(g) ==
    /\ g \notin circulating
    /\ g.base = version
    /\ pool >= g.mins
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ pool' = pool - g.mins
    /\ circulating' = circulating \cup {g}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED allotted

Apply(g) ==
    /\ g \in circulating
    /\ g.base = version
    /\ version < MaxVersion
    /\ allotted' = [allotted EXCEPT ![g.to] = @ + g.mins]
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {g}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED pool

\* An overtaken grant hands its minutes back rather than evaporating with them.
Return(g) ==
    /\ g \in circulating
    /\ (g.base # version \/ version = MaxVersion)
    /\ pool' = pool + g.mins
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {g}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<allotted, version>>

Release(t, m) ==
    /\ allotted[t] >= m
    /\ allotted' = [allotted EXCEPT ![t] = @ - m]
    /\ pool' = pool + m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<circulating, version>>

Reindex ==
    /\ version = MaxVersion
    /\ circulating = {}
    /\ version' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, allotted, circulating>>

Next ==
    \/ \E g \in Grants : Issue(g) \/ Apply(g) \/ Return(g)
    \/ \E t \in Theatres, m \in 1..MaxGrant : Release(t, m)
    \/ Reindex

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MinutesConserved ==
    pool + Banked(Theatres) + Carried(circulating) = Budget

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Theatres = {thrGreen, thrBlue}
    Budget = 2
    MaxGrant = 1
    MaxVersion = 2

INVARIANT MinutesConserved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler divides a fixed daily budget of theatre minutes. Minutes are
never created or destroyed: at every moment the budget is accounted for as minutes still in the
unallocated pool, minutes allotted to a theatre, and minutes travelling with a grant that has been
issued but not yet applied.

Grants are issued and applied under optimistic locking on the pool. A grant carries the pool
version it was issued against, and applying it requires that version still to be the pool's version;
grants circulate and are applied out of order, so a grant issued earlier may well be overtaken.
A grant that can no longer be applied is returned, and its minutes go straight back into the pool
rather than evaporating in transit.

The scheduler behaves as follows. A grant naming a theatre and a number of minutes may be issued
against the pool's current version while the pool holds at least that many minutes and the version
numbering has room; issuing takes the minutes out of the pool, puts the grant into circulation and
moves the version on. A circulating grant whose version is still the pool's version may be applied
while the numbering has room, which adds its minutes to that theatre's allotment and moves the
version on. A circulating grant whose version is no longer the pool's, or any circulating grant once
the numbering is spent, is returned, putting its minutes back in the pool. A theatre may release
minutes from its allotment back to the pool. When the numbering is spent and nothing is in
circulation, the version is reindexed to the start.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The minutes in the pool, the minutes allotted across the theatres and the minutes
travelling with circulating grants always add up to exactly the day's budget, so no theatre minute
is ever conjured up or lost in transit.

---- MODULE W4Od19m6p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patrons, Span, MaxRenewals, MaxOverrides, NoOne

VARIABLES keyWith, countdown, inside, renewals, overrides

vars == <<keyWith, countdown, inside, renewals, overrides>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ keyWith \in {NoOne} \cup Patrons
    /\ countdown \in 0..Span
    /\ inside \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ renewals \in 0..MaxRenewals
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
    /\ keyWith = NoOne
    /\ countdown = 0
    /\ inside = {}
    /\ renewals = 0
    /\ overrides = 0

Grant(p) ==
    /\ keyWith = NoOne
    /\ keyWith' = p
    /\ countdown' = Span
    /\ renewals' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inside, overrides>>

GoIn(p) ==
    /\ keyWith = p
    /\ countdown > 0
    /\ p \notin inside
    /\ inside' = inside \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<keyWith, countdown, renewals, overrides>>

ComeOut(p) ==
    /\ p \in inside
    /\ inside' = inside \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<keyWith, countdown, renewals, overrides>>

\* Renewals are rationed, so the countdown always runs out in the end.
Renew ==
    /\ keyWith # NoOne
    /\ countdown > 0
    /\ renewals < MaxRenewals
    /\ countdown' = Span
    /\ renewals' = renewals + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<keyWith, inside, overrides>>

\* A tick that brings the countdown to zero shows the room out in the same step.
Tick ==
    /\ countdown > 0
    /\ countdown' = countdown - 1
    /\ inside' = IF countdown - 1 = 0 THEN {} ELSE inside
    /\ UNCHANGED <<keyWith, renewals, overrides>>

Lapse ==
    /\ countdown = 0
    /\ keyWith # NoOne
    /\ keyWith' = NoOne
    /\ inside' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<countdown, renewals, overrides>>

\* The override changes hands and clears the room together; leaving somebody
\* inside across the handover is precisely the overlap the key rules out.
Override(p) ==
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ keyWith # NoOne
    /\ keyWith # p
    /\ keyWith' = p
    /\ countdown' = Span
    /\ inside' = {}
    /\ renewals' = 0
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Grant(p) \/ GoIn(p) \/ ComeOut(p) \/ Override(p)
    \/ Renew
    \/ Tick
    \/ Lapse

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Tick) /\ WF_vars(Lapse)

ReadingRoomExclusion ==
    \A p \in Patrons : p \in inside => (keyWith = p /\ countdown > 0)

KeyComesBack == (keyWith # NoOne) ~> (keyWith = NoOne)

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {patScholar, patVisitor, patFellow}
    Span = 3
    MaxRenewals = 1
    MaxOverrides = 1
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT ReadingRoomExclusion
PROPERTY KeyComesBack
nl:
A library's rare-books reading room is entered with a single key that one patron at a time may
hold. The key is held on a lease with a countdown rather than a wall clock: a grant sets the
countdown to its full span, and every tick of the desk's timer takes one off it. A patron may only
be inside the room while it holds the key and the countdown has not run out; when the countdown
reaches zero anyone inside is shown out there and then, and the lapsed lease is later cleared so
the key returns to the desk.

A lease may be renewed back to its full span, but only a fixed number of times per grant, so a
patron cannot sit on the key indefinitely.

The head librarian holds a privileged override and may, a bounded number of times per day, take
the key off whoever has it and hand it straight to another patron. The override shows the room out
in the same movement, sets the new lease to its full span and returns the renewal allowance,
because a patron left inside under a lease that has just changed hands would be exactly the
overlap the key exists to prevent.

The reading room behaves as follows. The desk may grant the key to a patron when the key is at the
desk, setting the countdown to its full span and returning the renewal allowance. The patron
holding the key with countdown left may go into the room. A patron inside may come out. The
holder's lease may be renewed to its full span while the countdown has not run out and the renewal
allowance is not spent. The timer may tick, taking one off the countdown and showing the room out
if that brings it to zero. A lapsed lease whose countdown has run out may be cleared, returning the
key to the desk. The head librarian may override, taking the key from its holder and handing it to
another patron.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every patron inside the reading room is the patron holding the key and its
countdown has not run out, so two patrons are never inside at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever the key is out with a patron, it eventually comes back to the desk.

---- MODULE W4Od3m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Accounts, MaxFigure, MaxEpoch, NoAck

Copies == [Accounts -> 0..MaxFigure]
Acks == [acct : Accounts, figure : 0..MaxFigure]

VARIABLES settled, working, stamp, acked, epoch

vars == <<settled, working, stamp, acked, epoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ settled \in Copies
    /\ working \in [Banks -> Copies]
    /\ stamp \in [Banks -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ acked \in [Banks -> {NoAck} \cup Acks]
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch

Init ==
    /\ settled = [a \in Accounts |-> 0]
    /\ working = [b \in Banks |-> [a \in Accounts |-> 0]]
    /\ stamp = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ acked = [b \in Banks |-> NoAck]
    /\ epoch = 1

TakeCopy(b) ==
    /\ working' = [working EXCEPT ![b] = settled]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![b] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, acked, epoch>>

\* A slow bank goes on raising figures in a copy whose stamp has long passed.
Raise(b, a, v) ==
    /\ v > working[b][a]
    /\ working' = [working EXCEPT ![b] = [working[b] EXCEPT ![a] = v]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, stamp, acked, epoch>>

\* Every post moves the epoch on, so no two posts can be made from copies taken
\* under the same epoch.
Post(b, a) ==
    /\ stamp[b] = epoch
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ settled' = working[b]
    /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![b] = [acct |-> a, figure |-> working[b][a]]]
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![b] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED working

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, working, stamp, acked>>

Renumber ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = 1
    /\ stamp' = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<settled, working, acked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : TakeCopy(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, a \in Accounts, v \in 0..MaxFigure : Raise(b, a, v)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, a \in Accounts : Post(b, a)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Renumber

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SettledFiguresHold ==
    \A b \in Banks : acked[b] # NoAck => settled[acked[b].acct] >= acked[b].figure

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Banks = {bkClearing, bkAgent}
    Accounts = {accNostro, accVostro}
    MaxFigure = 1
    MaxEpoch = 3
    NoAck = noAck

INVARIANT SettledFiguresHold
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch keeps a shared record of settled amounts per account. Amounts
only ever rise: a bank raises a figure in its own working copy of the whole record and later posts
that copy over the shared record. Because a post replaces the record wholesale, a copy taken before
somebody else's post would carry away every figure raised in between.

The batch is organised by epochs. Taking a copy stamps it with the epoch in force at that moment,
and a post is accepted only from a copy stamped with the epoch still in force. Every post itself
moves the batch to the next epoch, so at most one post can ever be made from any one epoch's copies;
a reconfiguration of the batch likewise moves the epoch on. Banks can be slow but never fail, so a
bank may go on raising figures in a copy stamped with an epoch that has long since passed, and its
post will simply not be accepted.

When a post is accepted the posting bank is acknowledged for one account and the figure its copy
carried for it.

The batch behaves as follows. A bank may take a fresh copy of the record, stamped with the epoch in
force. A bank may raise any account's figure in its own copy above what that copy holds, whether or
not its stamp is current. A bank whose copy is stamped with the epoch in force may post it over the
record while the epoch numbering has room, which moves the epoch on, re-stamps and refreshes that
bank's copy, and acknowledges the bank for one account and the figure it posted. The batch may be
reconfigured, moving the epoch on. When the epoch numbering is spent it is renumbered from the
start and every copy's stamp is voided.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acknowledgement a bank holds is still honoured by the record -- the account
it names stands at least at the figure acknowledged -- so no settled figure is ever carried away by
a later post.

---- MODULE W4Od19m9p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Branches, MaxEpoch, MinBin, MaxBin, NoOne

VARIABLES epoch, eligible, holder, feeding, bin, binCap

vars == <<epoch, eligible, holder, feeding, bin, binCap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ eligible \in SUBSET Branches
    /\ holder \in {NoOne} \cup Branches
    /\ feeding \in SUBSET Branches
    /\ bin \in 0..MaxBin
    /\ binCap \in MinBin..MaxBin

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ eligible = Branches
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ feeding = {}
    /\ bin = 0
    /\ binCap = MinBin

Admit(b) ==
    /\ b \in eligible
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ bin < binCap
    /\ holder' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, feeding, bin, binCap>>

Start(b) ==
    /\ holder = b
    /\ b \notin feeding
    /\ bin < binCap
    /\ feeding' = feeding \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, holder, bin, binCap>>

\* The item that fills the bin takes the chute with it.
Push(b) ==
    /\ b \in feeding
    /\ bin < binCap
    /\ bin' = bin + 1
    /\ feeding' = IF bin + 1 = binCap THEN {} ELSE feeding
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, holder, binCap>>

Stop(b) ==
    /\ b \in feeding
    /\ feeding' = feeding \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, holder, bin, binCap>>

GiveUp(b) ==
    /\ holder = b
    /\ b \notin feeding
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, feeding, bin, binCap>>

EmptyOne ==
    /\ bin > 0
    /\ bin' = bin - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, holder, feeding, binCap>>

\* A retune that leaves the bin with no room clears the chute in the same step.
Retune(v) ==
    /\ v # binCap
    /\ binCap' = v
    /\ feeding' = IF bin < v THEN feeding ELSE {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, eligible, holder, bin>>

Reconfigure(r) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ r # eligible
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ eligible' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, feeding, bin, binCap>>

Renumber ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ epoch' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<eligible, holder, feeding, bin, binCap>>

Stopping == \E b \in Branches : Stop(b)
Yielding == \E b \in Branches : GiveUp(b)

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Admit(b) \/ Start(b) \/ Push(b)
    \/ Stopping
    \/ Yielding
    \/ EmptyOne
    \/ \E v \in MinBin..MaxBin : Retune(v)
    \/ \E r \in SUBSET Branches : Reconfigure(r)
    \/ Renumber

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Stopping) /\ SF_vars(Yielding)

ChuteExclusion ==
    \A b \in Branches : b \in feeding => (holder = b /\ bin < binCap)

ChuteEventuallyUnheld == (holder # NoOne) ~> (holder = NoOne)

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Branches = {brnMain, brnAnnex}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MinBin = 1
    MaxBin = 2
    NoOne = noOne

INVARIANT ChuteExclusion
PROPERTY ChuteEventuallyUnheld
nl:
A library reservation system has one returns chute that a single branch may feed at a time. Which
branches are eligible is settled by an epoch-numbered reconfiguration, and the chute is handed out
by admitting one branch at a time as its recorded holder. A reconfiguration is only allowed while
the chute has no holder, so an eligibility change can never strip the branch that is currently
holding it.

The chute empties into a bin whose capacity is set at runtime, and the depot may retune that
capacity up or down at any moment. Feeding is only possible while the bin still has room: a branch
that fills the bin with its last item is taken off the chute there and then, and a retune that
leaves the bin with no room takes off whoever is feeding in the same movement. The bin may be
emptied one item at a time.

The system behaves as follows. An eligible branch may be admitted as the chute's holder while the
chute is unheld and the bin has room. The holder may start feeding while the bin has room. A branch
that is feeding may push an item into the bin while the bin has room, and if that item fills the bin
the chute is cleared. A branch that is feeding may stop. A holder that is not feeding may give the
chute up. The bin may be emptied by one item. The depot may retune the bin capacity to any value in
its permitted range, clearing the chute if the new capacity leaves no room. The eligible set may be
reconfigured to any different set while the chute is unheld, which takes the system to the next
epoch. When the epoch numbering is spent and the chute is unheld, the numbering restarts.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every branch feeding the chute is the chute's recorded holder and the bin still has
room, so two branches can never be feeding it at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever the chute has a holder, it is eventually unheld again.

---- MODULE W4Od6m2p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cars, Participants, Capacity, Quorum, NoBallot

Ballots == [car : Cars]

VARIABLES reserved, aboard, ballot, votes, dead

vars == <<reserved, aboard, ballot, votes, dead>>

\* What a car owes space to is reservations and occupants together.
Committed(c) == reserved[c] + aboard[c]

TypeOK ==
    /\ reserved \in [Cars -> 0..Capacity]
    /\ aboard \in [Cars -> 0..Capacity]
    /\ ballot \in {NoBallot} \cup Ballots
    /\ votes \in SUBSET Participants
    /\ dead \in SUBSET Participants

Init ==
    /\ reserved = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ aboard = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ ballot = NoBallot
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ dead = {}

Open(c) ==
    /\ ballot = NoBallot
    /\ Committed(c) < Capacity
    /\ ballot' = [car |-> c]
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, aboard, dead>>

Vote(p) ==
    /\ ballot # NoBallot
    /\ p \notin dead
    /\ p \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, aboard, ballot, dead>>

\* The room test is made again at commit time, not just when the ballot opened.
Take ==
    /\ ballot # NoBallot
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ Committed(ballot.car) < Capacity
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![ballot.car] = @ + 1]
    /\ ballot' = NoBallot
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aboard, dead>>

Abandon ==
    /\ ballot # NoBallot
    /\ ballot' = NoBallot
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, aboard, dead>>

\* Boarding turns a reservation into an occupancy, so the commitment is unchanged.
Board(c) ==
    /\ reserved[c] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ aboard' = [aboard EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, votes, dead>>

Lapse(c) ==
    /\ reserved[c] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aboard, ballot, votes, dead>>

GetOut(c) ==
    /\ aboard[c] > 0
    /\ aboard' = [aboard EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, ballot, votes, dead>>

Fail(p) ==
    /\ p \notin dead
    /\ Cardinality(dead) < Cardinality(Participants) - 1
    /\ dead' = dead \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, aboard, ballot, votes>>

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in dead
    /\ dead' = dead \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, aboard, ballot, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Open(c) \/ Board(c) \/ Lapse(c) \/ GetOut(c)
    \/ \E p \in Participants : Vote(p) \/ Fail(p) \/ Recover(p)
    \/ Take
    \/ Abandon

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CarsWithinCapacity == \A c \in Cars : Committed(c) <= Capacity

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Cars = {carHigh, carLow}
    Participants = {pnlLobby, ctlHigh, ctlLow}
    Capacity = 2
    Quorum = 2
    NoBallot = noBallot

INVARIANT CarsWithinCapacity
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper limits how many people each car may be committed to. A car's
commitment is everything it owes space to: passengers holding a reservation for it and passengers
already aboard it. That total may never exceed the car's capacity.

Reservations are made by a two-phase commit across the bank's participants -- the car controllers
and the lobby panels. A ballot is opened naming one car, participants vote on it, and the
reservation is only taken once a quorum has voted and the car still has room. A participant can
fail silently, so the bank cannot wait for everybody and works to a quorum instead; a ballot that
stalls is simply abandoned and can be opened again.

The bank behaves as follows. A ballot may be opened for a car that still has room, when no ballot
is open, which clears the vote tally. A live participant that has not yet voted on the open ballot
may vote. The open ballot may be taken once a quorum has voted and the named car still has room,
which adds a reservation to that car. The open ballot may be abandoned at any time. A passenger
holding a reservation for a car may board it, which turns the reservation into an occupancy without
changing what the car is committed to. A reservation may lapse, freeing the commitment. A passenger
aboard a car may get out. A participant may fail silently, so long as not all of them have, and a
failed participant may come back.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every car, the reservations held for it plus the passengers already aboard it
never exceed that car's capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od10m9p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cabins, Routes, MaxEpoch, NoRoute

\* Commands carry the epoch that issued them and arrive in any order, so the
\* stamp is the only thing that says whether one is still meant.
Commands == [route : Routes, ep : 1..MaxEpoch]

VARIABLES epoch, inService, setBy, setRoute, circulating

vars == <<epoch, inService, setBy, setRoute, circulating>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ inService \in SUBSET Cabins
    /\ setBy \in [Routes -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ setRoute \in [1..MaxEpoch -> {NoRoute} \cup Routes]
    /\ circulating \in SUBSET Commands

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ inService = Cabins
    /\ setBy = [r \in Routes |-> 0]
    /\ setRoute = [e \in 1..MaxEpoch |-> NoRoute]
    /\ circulating = {}

Issue(m) ==
    /\ m \notin circulating
    /\ m.ep = epoch
    /\ circulating' = circulating \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inService, setBy, setRoute>>

Meant(m) ==
    /\ m.ep = epoch
    /\ setBy[m.route] = 0
    /\ setRoute[m.ep] = NoRoute

\* Locking the route in stamps both records at once; there is no way back.
Execute(m) ==
    /\ m \in circulating
    /\ Meant(m)
    /\ setBy' = [setBy EXCEPT ![m.route] = m.ep]
    /\ setRoute' = [setRoute EXCEPT ![m.ep] = m.route]
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inService>>

Discard(m) ==
    /\ m \in circulating
    /\ ~Meant(m)
    /\ circulating' = circulating \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inService, setBy, setRoute>>

Reconfigure(c) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ c # inService
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ inService' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<setBy, setRoute, circulating>>

Consume(m) == Execute(m) \/ Discard(m)

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Commands : Issue(m) \/ Consume(m)
    \/ \E c \in SUBSET Cabins : Reconfigure(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ \A m \in Commands : WF_vars(Consume(m))

RouteSetAtMostOnce ==
    \A e \in 1..MaxEpoch : setRoute[e] # NoRoute => setBy[setRoute[e]] = e

EveryCommandLeaves ==
    \A m \in Commands : (m \in circulating) ~> (m \notin circulating)

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Cabins = {cabNorth, cabSouth}
    Routes = {rteUp, rteDown}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    NoRoute = noRoute

INVARIANT RouteSetAtMostOnce
PROPERTY EveryCommandLeaves
nl:
A subway signalling block system sets routes through its interlocking. Setting a route is
irreversible for the session: the interlocking is locked into that route and the route's own record
is stamped with the epoch that set it, while that epoch's record is stamped with the route it set.
Each epoch may set exactly one route, and a route may be set exactly once, so the two records are
mirrors -- a route set a second time under a later epoch would leave the earlier epoch still
pointing at it while the route pointed back at the later one.

Which signal cabins are in service is settled by an epoch-numbered reconfiguration, and every
reconfiguration takes the system to the next epoch. Set-route commands are stamped with the epoch
that issued them and reach the interlocking out of order and arbitrarily late. A command is carried
out only if its stamp is the epoch now in force, its route has not been set, and its epoch has not
already set something; a command failing any of those is discarded unexecuted.

The system behaves as follows. A cabin may issue a set-route command for a route, stamped with the
epoch now in force, if that exact command is not already in circulation. A circulating command whose
stamp is the epoch in force, whose route is unset and whose epoch has set nothing may be carried
out, which locks the route in and stamps both records. A circulating command failing any of those
tests is discarded. The set of cabins in service may be reconfigured to any different set, which
takes the system to the next epoch, so long as the epoch numbering has room.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every epoch that has set a route finds that route stamped back with that very
epoch, so the irreversible route setting happens at most once per route.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every command that enters circulation eventually leaves it.

---- MODULE W4Od14m7p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, MaxTag, MaxOrders, NoOne, NoTag

VARIABLES authority, tag, remembers, acting, standing

vars == <<authority, tag, remembers, acting, standing>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ authority \in {NoOne} \cup Drones
    /\ tag \in 0..MaxTag
    /\ remembers \in [Drones -> {NoTag} \cup (0..MaxTag)]
    /\ acting \in SUBSET Drones
    /\ standing \in SUBSET Drones

Init ==
    /\ authority = NoOne
    /\ tag = 0
    /\ remembers = [d \in Drones |-> NoTag]
    /\ acting = {}
    /\ standing = {}

\* Two ways to be cleared: the live register authority, or the commander's order.
Cleared(d) == (authority = d /\ remembers[d] = tag) \/ d \in standing

Claim(d) ==
    /\ authority = NoOne
    /\ tag < MaxTag
    /\ authority' = d
    /\ tag' = tag + 1
    /\ remembers' = [remembers EXCEPT ![d] = tag + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acting, standing>>

\* Giving the register up moves the tag, so it is barred while the holder acts.
GiveUp(d) ==
    /\ authority = d
    /\ d \notin acting
    /\ tag < MaxTag
    /\ authority' = NoOne
    /\ tag' = tag + 1
    /\ remembers' = [remembers EXCEPT ![d] = NoTag]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acting, standing>>

Begin(d) ==
    /\ d \notin acting
    /\ Cleared(d)
    /\ acting' = acting \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authority, tag, remembers, standing>>

Stop(d) ==
    /\ d \in acting
    /\ acting' = acting \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authority, tag, remembers, standing>>

Order(d) ==
    /\ d \notin standing
    /\ Cardinality(standing) < MaxOrders
    /\ standing' = standing \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authority, tag, remembers, acting>>

\* Rescinding grounds the drone unless it is cleared the other way.
Rescind(d) ==
    /\ d \in standing
    /\ standing' = standing \ {d}
    /\ acting' = IF authority = d /\ remembers[d] = tag THEN acting ELSE acting \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authority, tag, remembers>>

Reseal ==
    /\ tag = MaxTag
    /\ authority = NoOne
    /\ acting = {}
    /\ tag' = 0
    /\ remembers' = [d \in Drones |-> NoTag]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authority, acting, standing>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Claim(d) \/ GiveUp(d) \/ Begin(d) \/ Stop(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Order(d) \/ Rescind(d)
    \/ Reseal

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoUnclearedAction == \A d \in Drones : d \in acting => Cleared(d)

====

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Drones = {drnScout, drnTanker}
    MaxTag = 3
    MaxOrders = 1
    NoOne = noOne
    NoTag = noTag

INVARIANT NoUnclearedAction
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm decides which drone may release retardant. The right is held in
a compare-and-swap register carrying the drone that holds mission authority and a tag that moves on
every time the register changes. A drone claims the free register, taking the next tag and
remembering it; a drone may only act on the strength of that authority while it is still the
register's holder and the tag it remembers is still the register's tag.

The incident commander holds a privileged override: a bounded number of drones may be placed under a
standing order, and such a drone may act without the register at all. Rescinding a standing order
grounds that drone on the spot unless it happens to hold the register's live authority, because a
drone acting on an order that has just been withdrawn would be acting on nobody's say-so.

The swarm behaves as follows. A drone may claim the register while it is unheld and the tag
numbering has room, becoming the holder, moving the tag on and remembering it. The register's holder,
if it is not acting, may give the register up while the numbering has room, which moves the tag on
and clears what it remembers. A drone that is not acting may begin acting if it is the register's
holder remembering the current tag, or if it is under a standing order. A drone that is acting may
stop. The commander may place a drone under a standing order, up to the swarm's fixed limit. The
commander may rescind a standing order, grounding that drone unless it holds the register's live
authority. When the tag numbering is spent, the register is unheld and nobody is acting, the register
is resealed: the tag returns to zero and every drone's memory of it is cleared.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every acting drone is either the register's holder remembering the tag the register
still carries, or a drone under the commander's standing order, so no drone ever acts on a stale
authority or none at all.

---- MODULE W4Od12m6p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Wards, Slots, Cycle, Span, MaxOverrides, NoWard, NoSlot

VARIABLES holder, slotOf, deadline, clock, overrides

vars == <<holder, slotOf, deadline, clock, overrides>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in [Slots -> {NoWard} \cup Wards]
    /\ slotOf \in [Wards -> {NoSlot} \cup Slots]
    /\ deadline \in [Slots -> 0..Cycle]
    /\ clock \in 0..Cycle
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOverrides

Init ==
    /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> NoWard]
    /\ slotOf = [w \in Wards |-> NoSlot]
    /\ deadline = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ overrides = 0

Assign(w, s) ==
    /\ holder[s] = NoWard
    /\ slotOf[w] = NoSlot
    /\ clock + Span <= Cycle
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![w] = s]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Span]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, overrides>>

GiveBack(w) ==
    /\ slotOf[w] # NoSlot
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![slotOf[w]] = NoWard]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![slotOf[w]] = 0]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![w] = NoSlot]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, overrides>>

Clear(s) ==
    /\ holder[s] # NoWard
    /\ deadline[s] <= clock
    /\ slotOf' = [w \in Wards |-> IF slotOf[w] = s THEN NoSlot ELSE slotOf[w]]
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = NoWard]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, overrides>>

\* The override takes the previous holder's record with it; leaving it behind is
\* exactly the double allocation the two records rule out.
Override(w, s) ==
    /\ overrides < MaxOverrides
    /\ holder[s] # NoWard
    /\ deadline[s] <= clock
    /\ slotOf[w] = NoSlot
    /\ clock + Span <= Cycle
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = w]
    /\ slotOf' = [x \in Wards |->
                    IF x = w THEN s
                    ELSE IF slotOf[x] = s THEN NoSlot ELSE slotOf[x]]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![s] = clock + Span]
    /\ overrides' = overrides + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Tick ==
    /\ clock < Cycle
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, slotOf, deadline, overrides>>

NewCycle ==
    /\ clock = Cycle
    /\ \A s \in Slots : holder[s] = NoWard
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ deadline' = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, slotOf, overrides>>

Clearing == \E s \in Slots : Clear(s)

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Wards, s \in Slots : Assign(w, s) \/ Override(w, s)
    \/ \E w \in Wards : GiveBack(w)
    \/ Clearing
    \/ Tick
    \/ NewCycle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Tick) /\ WF_vars(Clearing)

RecordsMirror ==
    \A w \in Wards : slotOf[w] # NoSlot => holder[slotOf[w]] = w

ExpiredLeasesAreCleared ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        (holder[s] # NoWard /\ deadline[s] <= clock) ~> (holder[s] = NoWard)

====

SPECIFICATION Spec

CONSTANTS
    Wards = {wrdHaem, wrdTrauma}
    Slots = {sltMorning, sltEvening}
    Cycle = 3
    Span = 2
    MaxOverrides = 1
    NoWard = noWard
    NoSlot = noSlot

INVARIANT RecordsMirror
PROPERTY ExpiredLeasesAreCleared
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker hands transfusion slots to wards as leases. The pairing is recorded
twice -- each slot records the ward holding it, and each ward records the slot it holds -- and those
two records must mirror one another, since a slot handed to a second ward would leave the first
ward still pointing at a slot that now records somebody else.

Every lease carries a deadline on the bank's clock. A lease whose deadline has been reached is
expired and may be cleared, which frees the slot and clears the ward's record together. The
haematology consultant holds a privileged override and may, a bounded number of times per cycle,
take a slot whose lease has expired and hand it straight to another ward; the override clears the
previous holder's record in the same movement, because leaving it pointing at the slot is precisely
the double allocation the two records exist to rule out. The override may not touch a lease that is
still live.

The tracker behaves as follows. A ward holding no slot may be assigned a free slot, provided the new
deadline would fall inside the cycle; the deadline is set a fixed span ahead of the clock. A ward
holding a slot may give it back, freeing the slot. An expired lease may be cleared, freeing the slot
and the ward's record. The consultant may override an expired lease in favour of a ward holding no
slot, clearing the previous holder's record and setting a fresh deadline. The clock may tick. When
the cycle clock has run out and no slot is held, a fresh cycle begins with the clock back at the
start.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every ward that records holding a slot is the ward that slot records as its holder,
so a slot is never allocated to two wards at once.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every expired lease is eventually cleared, freeing its slot.
